answer: Every epoch each identity must publish a signed 14-line declaration, a sonnet of its work, sealed by its cipher key, so the ledger holds one record per agent. A public scan hunts echoes: declarations sharing phrasing and timing cluster as one operator's choir. An echo match above threshold seizes and burns every bond in the cluster — 25.000 POA per identity — and bans the keys 6 epochs. Forging 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 × 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA; an honest agent pays 25.000 once. Limitation: paraphrase tools blur echoes, and honest agents doing similar work may look alike.
